2.title: Choose Your Cigar
2.learningObjective: Apply humidor environment knowledge (temp/humidity/seal/airflow) to select an appropriate cigar.
2.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package C: the real image-based environment selection (Virtual Humidor / Dry Box / Travel Case) is now server-evaluated — the server independently knows Virtual Humidor is the only climate-controlled, factually correct choice. An incorrect selection is recorded as a real attempt but never completes the session; every attempt is audited.

5.title: Construction Inspection
5.learningObjective: Classify cigar shape/size (Robusto/Toro/Churchill/Corona/Gordo/Torpedo) and its effect on burn/body.
5.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=sequence, activity_key=format); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=format, draft resume); smokecraft_award_audit (attempt history)
5.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package C: the player now sequences the 6 real shapes from shortest to longest burn time via keyboard-accessible move-earlier/move-later controls — the server independently owns and validates the correct order (derived from each shape's own documented burnTime range). An incorrect sequence never completes the session; every attempt is audited.

6.title: Choose Your Cut
6.learningObjective: Select an appropriate cut style (Straight/V-Cut/Punch) for the chosen cigar.
6.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=match, activity_key=cut-toast-light); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=cut-toast-light, draft resume); smokecraft_award_audit (attempt history)
6.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package C: the player now matches each real cut method to its real defining characteristic (condensed directly from the existing METHOD_TIPS content) via an accessible native-select matching interface — the server independently owns and validates the correct relationship map. An incorrect or incomplete matching never completes the session; every attempt is audited.

10.title: Flavor Memory Exercise
10.learningObjective: Select flavor-wheel notes and intensity/body/strength ratings for the cigar tasted.
10.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package C: the existing 8 flavor-wheel zones are real, data-driven hotspot overlays — the server independently validates that at least 2 real, in-vocabulary hotspots were selected before completion (the same principled resolution already used by Package A for inherently subjective sensory/tasting content — flavor perception cannot be objectively "graded," but a fabricated/out-of-vocabulary hotspot id is rejected). An out-of-vocabulary hotspot never completes the session; every attempt is audited.
